subject: Archer: compact manifest & custody assertion for bulk evidence ingest
messages:
From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@heliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@heliohealth.com
Date: Sun, 8 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: compact manifest + custody assertion for Archer bulk evidence ingest

Hi Karthik,

Following our security intake call, Helio's audit team needs a compact manifest and a signed custody assertion for the bulk evidence bundle we'll pull into Archer. We're targeting an ingest window next week (Apr 11-12) but the auditor has a strict requirement: each evidence object must come with a SHA256 checksum in the manifest and a statement of custody for chain-of-possession.

Can Redwood provide:
- A compact CSV manifest template with columns (object_key, filename, size_bytes, sha256_hex, evidence_type, created_by, created_at, retention_tag)
- An exported mapping that ties Archer question IDs to our SIG/CArI/CAIQ fields so auditors can find answers next to evidence
- A signed custody assertion (PDF) that confirms temporary possession during the ingest window and retention semantics

Attachments: I attached our internal evidence upload checklist for context.

Thanks,
Jane
Security Program Manager
Helio Health

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: compact manifest + custody assertion for Archer bulk evidence ingest

Jane —

Thanks for the clear ask. High level plan below, we can iterate on the manifest shape if your audit team needs more fields.

Plan (we'll own the generation + delivery):
1) Manifest template: we'll produce a CSV manifest exactly with the columns you requested. We include an additional column "redwood_object_id" that maps back to our internal storage path. Sample attached (archer_manifest_sample.csv).

2) Checksums: we will compute SHA256 for each file server-side prior to issuing presigned URLs. Archer accepts either SFTP upload or presigned URL ingest; for presigned uploads we will include the checksum in the manifest and a separate checksum sidecar file if your ingest pipeline requires it.

3) Custody assertion: we'll prepare a short PDF (countersigned by Redwood security) that states: "Redwood Inference accepts temporary possession of the listed artifacts from Apr 11 00:00 to Apr 12 23:59 UTC for ingestion into Archer, after which artifacts will be deleted from the temporary staging bucket unless otherwise agreed." Draft will be shared as a DocuSign link for Helio signature.

4) Mapping to questionnaire IDs: Marissa will export the Archer->SIG/CAIQ mapping and an evidence lookup sheet (xlsx). That helps you attach evidence per question.

5) Ingest window SLA exception: we have scheduled infra maintenance Apr 13-14; to avoid conflict we request confirmation that Apr 12 23:59 UTC is acceptable as cutover. If Helio requires a longer possession window, we will need a signed SLA exception (short form).

Action items:
- Marissa: attach mapping xlsx and confirm format for Archer question id column.
- Ben: coordinate presigned URL expiry (we recommend 48 hours) and generate sidecar checksums.
- Jane: confirm ingest mechanism (SFTP vs presigned) and whether Helio will accept the custody PDF via DocuSign.

I'll assemble the draft custody PDF and manifest sample by EOD today.

- Karthik
Principal Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@heliohealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Apr 2028 13:28:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: compact manifest + custody assertion for Archer bulk evidence ingest

Adding the mapping and a short guidance note — attaching evidence-mapping-v0.3.xlsx. Key notes:
- Column A = Archer question id (e.g., ARCH-01234)
- Column D = recommended evidence_type (policy, screenshot, config, syslog)
- We include a quick lookup that maps Archer id -> SIG control id -> CAIQ attribute so auditors can see provenance.

Also: Archer expects the CSV manifest's header to match exactly; small formatting issues can cause a reject during automated ingest. Use the attached sample CSV (archer_manifest_sample.csv) as canonical.

Marissa
Vendor Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@heliohealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: audit@heliohealth.com
Date: Sun, 8 Apr 2028 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: compact manifest + custody assertion for Archer bulk evidence ingest

Team —

This is great, thanks. We will proceed with presigned uploads. Confirm the presigned URL TTL of 48 hours is acceptable. Helio auditors want the custody assertion delivered via DocuSign before we start the transfer.

Please send the DocuSign link and final draft of the custody PDF. Also confirm the retention_tag values you will include (Helio expects "audit:year=2028;policy=SOC2:TypeA").

I'll route the mapping to our vendor intake team and confirm the final ingest start time tomorrow.

Regards,
Jane
